text:
hana: Heads-up - noticed a recurring preview -> invoice divergence pattern this morning tied to a small set of high-throughput tenants. preview shows lower token totals for a 2-3 minute window, final invoice has the full tokens. seems correlated with consumer checkpoint commits and shard rebalances. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/watermark-lag

bryan: any sample event or offsets?

hana: sanitized sample event and consumer snapshot:
```
{
  "tenant": "t-zen",
  "event_id": "e-9031",
  "tokens": 256,
  "route_hint": "pinned-us-east",
  "ingest_seq": 1002345,
  "kafka_offset": null,
  "preview_indexed_at": null
}
// consumer checkpoint snapshot: shard-12 last_committed_offset=135790, last_consumed_offset=135792, last_commit_ts=2026-03-22T09:02:01Z
```

marta: Interesting - the preview indexer reads the committed offset per-shard and stops; if a consumer consumes but hasn't committed (due to batching or rebalance), finalizer which replays from the topic end sees the message and invoices it. so preview lags behind by the commit window.

console-ux: From a UX standpoint customers are confused by preview lag. Proposal: show a small "watermark" indicator in preview header that says last_consistent_at: 09:01:58 UTC and add tooltip: "Preview is consistent up to this watermark. Events after the watermark may appear in invoice if consumers commit later." FF: `ui.preview_watermark` (default on for internal).

billing-ops: Support requests spike whenever delta > 0.7% for >5m. We need a quick mitigation to avoid surprises while infra fix is implemented.

bryan: Infra options: (1) make preview reader use end offsets (dangerous for in-progress events), (2) have finalizer emit a stable "preview_ready" watermark event when it commits offsets so indexer can use that, (3) reduce commit latency by forcing more frequent commits (costly). I prefer (2) - cheap and explicit.

hana: Plan: 1) Instrument `preview.watermark_lag_ms` per-shard + `consumer.commit_delay_ms`. 2) Implement a lightweight "watermark marker" in finalizer: after committing offset X for shard S, finalizer writes a compacted watermark event `wm:{shard:S,offset:X,ts}` to a `metering.watermarks` topic. preview indexer will tail that topic and advance its watermark accordingly. 3) UI: wire `last_consistent_at` to watermark.

marta: Implementation notes: finalizer already has commit hooks. We'll add a non-blocking fire-and-forget write to watermark topic. preview indexer subscribe to watermarks topic in addition to committed topic and use the highest offset per-shard to compute watermark. small canary in us-east for 30m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy watermark-emitter -> us-east shard-12 canary at 09:30 UTC. rollback if `preview.watermark_lag_ms` increases or `watermark.emitter_errors > 0.1%` for >5m.

billing-ops: Also request a nightly reconciliation CSV: columns = [tenant, date, preview_tokens, invoice_tokens, delta_pct, top_routes]. Auto-attach to support tickets when delta_pct > 1%.

console-ux: We'll add `last_consistent_at` to the preview header and a small explanatory modal. FF will allow UX team to iterate text before wide release. will attach figma mock to the RFC.

hana: Action items: marta - PR for watermark emitter + tests; bryan - preview-indexer subscribe to watermarks and metric exports; console-ux - FF + mock; billing-ops - CSV schema and threshold for auto-ticketing. sync 20m before canary to validate rollback playbook.

bryan: one more concern: route attribution. when a rebalance happens, route_hint may change during replay. we should ensure the preview/preview_watermark join uses the `ingest_seq` (strongly monotonic) as canonical key for attribution to avoid attribution flips. add metric `attribution.flips_rate`.

marta: ack - we'll preserve `ingest_seq` in watermark emission to help joins. also will add unit tests that simulate rebalance and offset commit racing.

hana: thanks. let's keep canary small and monitor `preview.to.invoice.delta` and `support.ticket_rate` closely. prefer conservative rollout. :thumbsup:
